summary: Simpler cloud setup, a dedicated Files workspace, and clearer software updates.

improvements: Deploy your private agent to your cloud from one guided action; new setups include the encrypted Files library.
Browse folders and files in a dedicated workspace with upload, search, and organization controls.
fixes: Missing cloud billing now offers a direct setup link and resumes the recorded project after fresh authorization.
Settings and Feed show the same verified update stages and retain the installed version during refresh.
A failed update can send a bounded diagnostic report only after the owner chooses to send it.
security: Files content analysis remains off until the owner opts in.
Update completion requires installed-image and recovery verification; logs are not sent automatically.
